BETA Close X Serco Group plc has purchased a total of 1,208,394 ordinary shares on March 16, 17, 18, 19, and 20, 2026, as part of its share buyback program. The average price paid per share across these transactions was approximately 315.06 pence. Following these purchases, Serco Group plc has 1,000,412,924 ordinary shares in issue, excluding treasury shares, and a total of 2,333,090 ordinary shares held in treasury. The total number of voting rights in the company, excluding treasury shares, is 1,000,412,924 as of March 20, 2026.
